meta.disclaimer: Not filed data and not derivable from filings. Each figure carries its own basis and confidence.

CRWV.basis: Pure-play GPU neocloud with no legacy business line: revenue is AI compute rental, $1.92B to $5.13B in one year. Residual non-AI is negligible.
sources: SEC filed revenue FY2023-2025 + company description; Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026, not operator-researched

SIVE.basis: InP CW laser photonics is the growth story but not yet the revenue: Q1 2026 net sales SEK 61.9m fell 22% YoY and the $799m figure is an opportunity pipeline, not backlog. Legacy wireless/mmWave still carries much of the base.
sources: Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026 — inferred from SEC filed revenue, company segment mix and store thesis data. NOT operator-researched, NOT a filed segment figure.

AAOI.basis: Datacenter optical transceivers are the bulk of a book that doubled to $0.46B, sold out beyond next year on 800G/1.6T. A legacy CATV/telecom segment remains but is the minority.
sources: Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026 — inferred from SEC filed revenue, company segment mix and store thesis data. NOT operator-researched, NOT a filed segment figure.

LITE.basis: Revenue jumped $1.65B to $3.01B in one year almost entirely on datacenter lasers and transceivers; an industrial and telecom laser segment still carries the remainder.
sources: Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026 — inferred from SEC filed revenue, company segment mix and store thesis data. NOT operator-researched, NOT a filed segment figure.

AMD.basis: Company-reported segment revenue, updated to the latest filed quarter: Data Center was $6,718m of $11,536m in Q2 2026, or 58.2%, against $3,240m of $7,685m (42.2%) a year earlier. Segment operating income swung to $2,103m from a $155m loss. The prior basis read 47.9% on FY2025 and understated the current mix. Client, Gaming and Embedded are the balance, and Gaming fell 31%.
sources: AMD Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, filed 5 Aug 2026 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2488/000000248826000123/amd-20260627.htm
Transcribed by Claude from that filing, not operator-researched.

NBIS.basis: Pure-play AI cloud: revenue $0.09B to $0.53B, up 454% YoY at roughly 50% AI Cloud adjusted EBITDA margin, with no material legacy business.
sources: Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026 — inferred from SEC filed revenue, company segment mix and store thesis data. NOT operator-researched, NOT a filed segment figure.

AXTI.basis: Re-cut on the filed half-year after the 1 Sep seat research found the prior basis stale. Quarterly revenue rose 164.8% to $47.6m and gross margin from 8.0% to 44.9%, so the InP price hikes HAVE landed — the earlier note said they had not. Photonics-grade InP is now the majority of the mix; legacy GaAs into LED and wireless is the shrinking balance. Still a judgement: AXT discloses no AI or photoni
sources: AXT Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, filed 13 Aug 2026 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1051627/000143774926027677/axti20260630_10q.htm
Claude desk estimate re-cut 11 Sep 2026 from that filing. NOT operator-researched, NOT a filed segment figure.

MU.basis: Micron states the figure directly: data centre reached a record 56% of company revenue in FY2025, $20.75B of $37.4B, up 137%. Mobile, embedded, auto and consumer NAND are the remainder.
sources: Micron FY2025 Q4 results and prepared remarks, Sep 2025 — investors.micron.com. The 56% is Micron's own stated share. Transcribed by Claude, not operator-researched.

COHR.basis: Datacenter optical transceivers and lasers drove $5.81B to $7.12B, but a large industrial laser and engineered materials book sits underneath at roughly half.
sources: Claude desk estimate delegated by operator 28 Aug 2026 — inferred from SEC filed revenue, company segment mix and store thesis data. NOT operator-researched, NOT a filed segment figure.

TSM.basis: Still a judgement: TSMC does NOT disclose AI as a share of revenue. Anchored to a third-party estimate of $9.1B AI-related chip sales in 2024 against the $88.3B on file, about 10%. Do not read the HPC platform share (~51%) as AI — it is mostly non-AI compute.
sources: AI share not disclosed by TSMC; $9.1B 2024 estimate from The Next Platform, 16 Oct 2025, which states plainly that TSMC's last hard figure was 6% in June 2023. 2025 is tracking to high-teens, so this
